source.title: Call for Applicants - WST Leader (May 2021)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Software Team (WST) Leader**. The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 10 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong technical expertise
* Good communication
* Problem solving skills
* Goal-oriented
* Project management experience

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **June 1st, 2021, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WST Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WST can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2021.11](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.11%20-%20Software%20Team.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2021.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 软件组负责人招募（2021 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的**软件组（WST）负责人**。申请面向所有 WCA 成员开放，无须目前已在组织中任职。

申请人应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周为团队工作至少 10 小时。我们希望申请人具备以下条件：

* 扎实的专业技术能力。
* 良好的沟通能力。
* 解决问题的能力。
* 能围绕目标开展工作。
* 项目管理经验。

申请材料提交截止时间为 **2021 年 6 月 1 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请将申请私下发送给 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

<!-- break -->

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
* 担任 WCA 软件组负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料。

WST 的权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2021.11](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.11%20-%20Software%20Team.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，经高级代表和现任委员会/团队负责人投票确认后公布。流程见 [WCA 决议 10.2021.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
